description: Transfer to third country processor or controller does not utilize European Commission approved Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs). Article 46.2.c allows transfers based on SCCs adopted by the Commission.
applicability: Applicable when transferring data to third countries without adequacy decision and relying on contractual safeguards. SCCs must be Commission-approved and not modified.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through contract review with third country vendors and absence of valid SCCs or use of outdated SCC versions.
